image_description: A close-up photograph of a small, slender snake being held in a human hand. The snake has a glossy, dark brown to black dorsal surface with smooth scales and a lighter, possibly pinkish or greyish ventral side visible near the head. The head is blunt and rounded, barely distinct from the neck. The background is blurred green foliage.
